about: Settings measured as a loss (LAUNCHER-1225 step 2, idea from the scout's planner study). The planner and the auto-tune never pick a row's setting inside its scope; when the user sets one, the launcher says what was measured and runs it anyway (the user's flags win). Each row names its evidence; one-run rows are forecasts. A row is removed only by a new measurement that beats it.
